spanish: En éver del Jordán, en tierra de Moab, comenzó Moisés a explicar esta torá, diciendo:

findings.issue: Common noun (construct) is left as the transliteration éver instead of Spanish.
Common noun is left as the transliteration torá instead of Spanish.
Hiphil perfect H2974 (willing / undertake / begin) is narrowed to comenzó, and the following piel perfect is smoothed to an infinitive.

notes: Jordán, Moab, and Moisés match the proper names; the object marker is rightly untranslated.
